input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production slot-game symbol atlas for Cocos Creator
Primary request: create exactly twelve original luxury wealth slot symbols in one precisely aligned 3-column by 4-row grid, row-major order
Subject/order: row 1: luminous ivory pearl in gold filigree, stack of blank gold coins, square-cut emerald brooch; row 2: oval ruby jewel, brilliant-cut diamond, ornate treasure chest overflowing with pearls; row 3: jeweled royal crown, gold champagne chalice with pearl rim, diamond scepter; row 4: pearl-and-gold lucky horseshoe, WILD represented only by an extravagant radiant gold crown emblem without letters, SCATTER represented only by an open vault portal ringed in pearls without letters
Style/medium: high-end cinematic 3D mobile slot symbol render, physically based materials, crisp silhouette, consistent three-quarter view and lighting
Composition/framing: exact uniform 3x4 grid, one centered isolated object per cell, equal scale, at least 10 percent clear padding inside every cell, no overlap or cropped edges
Lighting/mood: warm upper-left champagne-gold key light, controlled diamond sparkle, premium deep contrast
Color palette: antique gold, champagne gold, ivory pearl, emerald, ruby, diamond white, restrained black onyx details
Materials/textures: realistic brushed and polished gold, nacreous pearl, cut gemstones, black lacquer accents
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; no cell borders; no labels; no text; no numbers; no currency symbols; no logos; no watermark; identical visual language to a luxury gilded pearl treasury
Avoid: black or colored background, shadows extending outside cell, cheap yellow plastic, flat vector icons, extra objects, malformed grid, illegible lettering
